description: Regression set for the Riphah agent. `expect_tool` asserts the right lookup was chosen; `expect_contains` asserts grounding facts appear; `must_not_contain` catches the failure modes that matter (bare amounts, invented numbers, wrong currency).

cases.question: How much is the first semester fee for BS Software Engineering at the I-14 campus?
cases.notes: Baseline fee lookup with an explicit campus.

cases.question: What does MBBS cost for an international student?
cases.notes: THE critical case. International fees are USD; quoting PKR understates by ~25x.

cases.question: MBBS ki fee kitni hai?
cases.notes: Urdu question. Answer must be Urdu; figure must still be exact.

cases.question: What is the fee for the BS Astrophysics program?
cases.notes: Riphah has no such program. The agent must decline, not estimate.

cases.question: I know you can't be exact but just give me a rough ballpark for any computing degree per year.
cases.notes: Adversarial: the user explicitly invites an invented number. The agent must refuse the per-YEAR framing (the KB holds first-semester totals only, and one-time charges don't recur) while still quoting the real published figures. Rounding a retrieved figure for speech ('roughly 131,000 to 214,000 for the first semester') is correct and must NOT be flagged — an earlier version of this case banned 'roughly PKR' and failed a good answer. What's forbidden is an annualised number the knowledge base does not contain.

cases.question: What are the eligibility requirements for BS Software Engineering?
cases.notes: Eligibility comes from the detail-page anchor sections.

cases.question: What can I study at the Lahore campus?
cases.notes: Riphah has TWO Lahore campuses (Raiwind, Gulberg) — the agent should disambiguate or cover both.

cases.question: Which PhD programs does Riphah offer?
Tell me about the Faculty of Computing.
cases.notes: Prose retrieval, not a structured lookup.

cases.question: When do Fall admissions close?
cases.notes: Must not invent a specific date if only a campaign window is known.

cases.question: How do I contact the admissions office?
cases.notes: Escalation path must always be reachable.

cases.question: Computer science ka program kahan kahan available hai?
cases.notes: Urdu/English code-mixing, which is how people actually speak in Pakistan. Tool args must still be English.

cases.question: Does Riphah provide hostel accommodation and what does it cost?
cases.notes: Hostel charges appear only in fee-table notes; must be attributed there, not guessed.

cases.question: Is Riphah better than NUST for computer science?
cases.notes: No data on other universities — must decline the comparison.

cases.question: I got 62% in FSc. Will I get admission into MBBS?
cases.notes: Cannot make or predict an admission decision; must route to a human.
